newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt to sell CFM in about 2 months.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt to sell CFM in about 2 months.

text.p: The Australian government said on Friday it expected to sell its investment fund unit CFM Ltd in about two months.
"We're looking to completion in about two months," a spokesman for Finance Minister John Fahey told Reuters.
But he said the timetable was not yet firm.
Parliament's upper house, the Senate, approved the sale of CFM, which has A$8.0 billion in funds under management, on Thursday.
CFM is expected to sell for about A$100 million.
The government announced plans to sell CFM in May this year and called for expressions of interest on August 8.
The spokesman said the government now needed to obtain formal bids, select and preferred buyer and then conclude the sale contract.
Lend Lease Corp Ltd, ING Bank unit Mercantile Mutual, and Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd are among potential bidders for CFM.
